The Process

From Discovery to Results in 4 Steps

No lengthy engagements. No bloated tech stacks. Just focused work that gets you measurable outcomes fast.

1

Discovery Call (Free)

We map out your biggest time and money drains — the manual work, the bottlenecks, the reporting gaps. I listen first, then identify where AI can deliver the fastest wins.

2

Custom AI Blueprint

You receive a clear, prioritized action plan: which workflows to automate first, what tools to use, estimated time savings, and projected cost reduction — before we spend a dollar on implementation.

3

Build & Deploy

I build, test, and deploy your AI systems — integrating with your existing tools (CRM, email, accounting software, Slack, and more). Minimal disruption to your team during rollout.

4

Optimize & Scale

After launch, I monitor performance, fine-tune the systems, and identify the next automation opportunities so the ROI compounds over time.

What This Looks Like for a Real Business

Here's a real-world example of the kind of transformation AI consulting delivers — across the exact areas that drain most small and mid-size businesses.

Case Study
Meridian Property Group
Real Estate Management — 12 employees, $4M annual revenue
28 hrs
Saved per week
$62K
Annual cost savings
6 weeks
To full deployment
The Problem

Meridian's office manager was spending nearly 3 full days per week on manual tasks: pulling rent payment data into spreadsheets, answering the same tenant inquiries over email, scheduling maintenance visits back-and-forth, and compiling monthly financial reports for the owners by hand. Their team was overwhelmed, response times were slow, and the owners had no real-time visibility into the business's financial health.

What We Built

Automated financial reporting — a live dashboard pulling from their property management software, generating owner reports every Monday at 8am with zero manual work.

AI tenant support bot — trained on their lease terms, policies, and FAQs. Handles 80% of tenant inquiries instantly, 24/7. Complex issues escalate to staff automatically.

Smart maintenance scheduling — tenants submit requests via a form; the system auto-assigns contractors, books time slots, and sends confirmations without staff involvement.

Automated rent arrears workflow — detects overdue payments and sends escalating reminder sequences, eliminating the manual follow-up process entirely.

“
We went from spending half our week on admin to actually managing and growing the portfolio. The financial reports alone saved us hours every month — and now we actually know our numbers in real time. I wish we'd done this two years ago.
— Sarah T., Operations Manager, Meridian Property Group
